subject: physics
content:
A screw gauge having 100 equal divisions and a pitch of length 1 mm is used to measure the diameter of a wire of length 5.6 cm. The main scale reading is 1mm and 47<sup>th</sup> circular division coincides
with the main scale. Find the curved surface area of wire in cm<sup>2</sup> to appropriate significant figures.
